listing.name: ShroudedKnowledge endgame
listing.summary: I was wondering why the Shroud faction lacked content related to colonies or the endgame. I checked the forums to see if anything like that already existed, but I couldn't find anything. I was also curious about how Starsector mods are made, so I decided to give modding a try and create this mod.
listing.aiSummary: Adds an endgame crisis for the Shroud faction featuring a threat system that escalates through fleet battles.

description:
Compatibility
Starsector: 0.98a-RC8
Almost all assets and code in this mod were created using AI tools: GPT-6 Luna
I was wondering why the Shroud faction lacked content related to colonies or the endgame. I checked the forums to see if anything like that already existed, but I couldn't find anything.
I was also curious about how Starsector mods are made, so I decided to give modding a try and create this mod. Almost everything was generated with ChatGPT (GPT-6 Luna), though.
It was a fun experiment, and I'd love to hear what you think! I'm still learning how to program, so I know there's plenty of room for improvement. I'll keep refining things as I go, and any help or feedback would be greatly appreciated!                                                                                                                                                                               I think "vibe coding" is something I could easily fall into :P

How it works
You gain points destro                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The crisis progresses through a threat system ranging from 0 to 300 points.
You earn points by defeating Shroud fleets: Lesser Manifestation 20 pts, Greater Manifestation 30 pts, Transcendent Manifestation 50 pts.
As the threat grows, the Sector approaches two major milestones:

150 Threat Points: Preparations for the first Shroud manifestation begin.

300 Threat Points: A Shrouded Dweller expedition is launched.

https://github.com/IcarosA2000/ShroudedKnowledge
